House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a youth shelter facility in the city of St. Cloud.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+180 DEGREES; YOUTH SHELTER FACILITY. +]

[+$856,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to 180 Degrees to construct, furnish, and equip improvements necessary for renovation of a youth shelter facility located at 1101 Washington Memorial Drive in the city of St. Cloud to improve program delivery onsite and provide space for a teen employment center and donation center. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a youth shelter facility in the city of St. Cloud.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. 180 DEGREES; YOUTH SHELTER FACILITY.

$856,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to 180 Degrees to construct, furnish, and equip improvements necessary for renovation of a youth shelter facility located at 1101 Washington Memorial Drive in the city of St. Cloud to improve program delivery onsite and provide space for a teen employment center and donation center. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $856,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to 180 Degrees to construct, furnish, and equip improvements necessary for renovation of a youth shelter facility located at 1101 Washington Memorial Drive in the city of St. Cloud to improve program delivery onsite and provide space for a teen employment center and donation center. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
